SELECT
    channel,
    round(avg_transaction_value, 2) AS avg_transaction_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Online' AS channel,
        avg(order_total) AS avg_transaction_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            SalesOrderNumber,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS order_total
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
    )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Store' AS channel,
        avg(SalesAmount) AS avg_transaction_value
    FROM retail.FactSales
)
ORDER BY channel
